_about: Template for the local, untracked config/repos.json — copy it there and register the repos this machine actually uses; delete entries freely, nothing in code names a repo. Entries are pointers only (clone URL, local checkout, remote dest, declared venv path, init_venv.py invocation, version checks, import-scan roots, optional variant deltas). A package list in an entry is rejected: each repo's spec lives in its own init_venv.py.
